title: Large-Scale Hate Speech Detection with Cross-Domain Transfer
findings: The study analyzed hate speech detection across five domains, including religion. Key findings show high cross-domain transferability for the religion domain. Models trained on other domains (gender, race, politics, sports) recovered 98% of the performance on the religion domain for English and 93% for Turkish on average. Conversely, models trained on religious hate speech generalized well to other domains, showing an average performance decay of only 3% in both languages, which was the second-best generalization performance after the gender domain in English.
